default_rule: A validator or validation-like script is not a current gate merely because it exists. Current execution authority requires explicit registration here or a later machine-enforced successor registry.

cybalicistjt-stack/multiversal-aioc.disposition: AIOC retains historical validators as provenance and diagnostic reference, but CRS-03 removed every live Actions caller. CRS-06 will introduce a new repository-health validator rather than reactivating legacy validators by default.

current_validation_core.purpose: Execute explicitly declared governed validation profiles with runner preflight and compact diagnostics.
Verify runner, toolchain, checkout and workspace contract without mutating persistent host state.
Generate deterministic receipts and lane-specific evidence.
Compare deterministic Linux/Windows receipts on the exact candidate head.

current_compatible_manual_checks.purpose: Manual lightweight runner smoke only; not a feature completion gate.

historical_inert_patterns: historical tranche-specific tests invoked only by workflows removed in CRS-03
cybalicistjt-stack/Multiversal-app.execution_rule: A new or resumed production tranche may call a feature-specific validator only through a newly reviewed thin Validation Core profile or a documented capability exception. Historical validator existence never grants gate authority.

lifecycle_assumption_findings.finding: These strings remain in historical A2/PPIA documentation and in task-capsule vocabulary. They are not current project-state prerequisites. Historical A2 validators/tests that require A2 to remain in those states are HISTORICAL_INERT.
lifecycle_assumption_findings.current_safe_case: tools/mv_dev/task_capsule.py may retain the vocabulary because it reports lifecycle states dynamically; callers may not assert an obsolete historical state as a universal current condition.

lifecycle_assumption_findings.finding: Occurrences remain in historical workflow definitions in Git history, historical VCH migration proof, and governance text discussing audits or prior policy. CRS-03 leaves no AIOC automatic workflow and no App automatic GitHub-hosted completion workflow live.
lifecycle_assumption_findings.current_rule: Self-hosted Windows plus self-hosted Linux plus deterministic comparison is the normal final gate where cross-platform proof is relevant; GitHub-hosted execution is optional independent audit unless a new explicit capability requirement says otherwise.

lifecycle_assumption_findings.pattern: fixed historical branch, PR, tranche or stage state
lifecycle_assumption_findings.finding: Such assertions may remain inside sealed historical evidence validators, but they cannot be selected by CURRENT_WORK_POINTER.json, a live workflow, or a current completion gate unless explicitly reclassified during the relevant resumed work.
